label_groups.name: default

moon_form.name: invoice_number
moon_form.instructions: Extract the invoice number.

moon_form.name: invoice_date
moon_form.instructions: Extract the date the invoice was issued.

moon_form.name: due_date
moon_form.instructions: Extract the date the invoice payment is due.

moon_form.name: po_reference
moon_form.instructions: Extract the customer purchase order (PO) reference number.

moon_form.name: vendor_name
moon_form.instructions: Extract the name of the vendor or supplier to whom payment should be remitted.

moon_form.name: vendor_address
moon_form.instructions: Extract the full address of the vendor or supplier to which payment should be remitted.

moon_form.name: subtotal
moon_form.instructions: Extract the subtotal amount of the invoice before tax and freight. If a currency code is missing, assume USD.

moon_form.name: tax
moon_form.instructions: Extract the tax amount applied to the invoice. If a currency code is missing, assume USD.

moon_form.name: freight
moon_form.instructions: Extract the freight or shipping cost. If a currency code is missing, assume USD.

moon_form.name: total
moon_form.instructions: Extract the total amount due for the invoice in USD. If a currency code is missing, assume USD.

label_defs.name: invoice > line_items
label_defs.instructions: Extract details for each line item on the invoice.

moon_form.name: item_description
moon_form.instructions: Extract the description of the item.

moon_form.name: quantity
moon_form.instructions: Extract the quantity of the item.

moon_form.name: unit_price
moon_form.instructions: Extract the unit price of the item. If a currency code is missing, assume USD.

moon_form.name: extended_amount
moon_form.instructions: Extract the extended amount for the line item (quantity * unit price). If a currency code is missing, assume USD.
